categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: lang correct on both locales: 53 en, 10 ru, 0 mismatches
hreflang reciprocal across all four endpoints in both pairs
63/63 canonical, self-referencing, 0 mismatches
63/63 pages return 200, 0 redirects, 0 orphans, 404s return a real 404
Sitemap at 51 URLs with tag archives excluded, matching their noindex
Security headers all app-level: HSTS preload, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
x-nextjs-cache: HIT — static generation intact through two refactors
/llms.txt serves 200 as text/plain

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: The one missing control on an otherwise hardened privacy-branded site.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP header in next.config.mjs or Caddy.

findings.title: x-powered-by: Next.js still exposed
findings.description: Response header discloses the framework.
findings.recommendation: Set poweredByHeader: false in next.config.mjs.

findings.title: 404 page ships without a stylesheet link
findings.description: Next 14 renders the not-found boundary outside every layout when an app has two root layouts. Status 404 and noindex are intact and not-found.tsx rebuilds the chrome, but CSS arrives via the client chunk.
findings.recommendation: Accept, or migrate to app/[locale]/ with a middleware rewrite — a large change for a Low finding.

findings.title: /ru/* misses render the English 404
findings.description: Same root cause as above.
findings.recommendation: Accept, or address with the item above.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 8 /alternatives/* pages rewritten from 170-195 to 626-679 words
Each has a fair 'what they get right' section, a named gap, a six-row table, switch-if/stay-if lists and 4 FAQs
Feature pages now 573-727 words, comparison pages 562-619
Pages under 300 words: 63/94 live -> 42/63 -> 34/63
Median words: 175 -> 218 -> 260
0 pages missing H1, 0 heading-level skips

findings.title: 10 /guides/* pages at 218-273 words
findings.description: private-messenger-for-crypto 218, decentralized-messaging-app 220, encrypted-messaging-app-for-iphone 230, messaging-app-that-doesnt-track-you 231, blockchain-messaging-app 232, serverless-messaging-app 238, web3-messaging-app 239, anonymous-messaging-app 265, most-private-messaging-app-2026 273, private-messaging-app-without-phone-number 378. They already carry FAQ blocks and FAQPage schema, so only the body copy is thin.
findings.recommendation: Apply the /alternatives/* template: fair framing, concrete implementation, a decision table, and who-this-is-not-for. Target 600+.

findings.title: Head-term cannibalization, unresolved
findings.description: /best-private-messaging-apps (786w) and /guides/most-private-messaging-app-2026 (273w) still target the same query.
findings.recommendation: Editorial decision: pick the canonical target, subordinate or merge the other, have it link up.

findings.title: 8 glossary pages at 105-152 words
findings.description: cover-traffic 105, serverless-messenger 114, end-to-end-encryption 117, double-ratchet 120, forward-secrecy 128, metadata 135, bip-39-seed-phrase 146, stealth-address 152. Now the thinnest section on the site.
findings.recommendation: Take each to ~300 with a worked example, why it matters, and how PrivaMesh implements it.

findings.title: /news still 26 words
findings.description: 4 empty H2s, indexed and in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Populate or de-index.

findings.title: E-E-A-T unchanged
findings.description: /about 353 words with no named team. Only two external domains linked sitewide: github.com (257) and x.com (64). No citations to X3DH, Double Ratchet or BIP-39 despite the product being built on them.
findings.recommendation: Cite the specifications, name the team, link third-party coverage.

findings.title: Section index pages read thin by word count
findings.description: /blog 131, /ru/blog 132, /alternatives 219, /glossary 260. Navigational pages — the count is expected.
findings.recommendation: No action.

findings.title: 17 pages at exactly 1 inbound internal link
findings.description: All 10 /guides/* and all 7 /glossary/* detail pages are reachable only from their own index.

findings.title: 4 RU tag descriptions under 70 chars

findings.title: Home page still 171KB with an always-on canvas
findings.description: Heaviest page on the site, then /best-private-messaging-apps 122KB and /compare/privamesh-vs-signal 111KB. NetworkBackground has run continuously during scroll since 32440a1, and this is the LCP page. Untouched by any of the three commits.
findings.recommendation: Measure INP; consider pausing the canvas off-viewport.

findings.title: No LCP/INP/CLS measurement exists
findings.description: No Chrome installed. This category has been an estimate in all three audits.
findings.recommendation: Install Chrome, run Lighthouse, connect CrUX.

limitations: Local build, not production: no Caddy, no HTTP/3, no edge cache, no real latency. Security headers were confirmed app-level so they carry over; timing numbers do not.
4 EN and 4 RU blog posts exist only on the live server, so content and internal-link figures understate the real site. The 6 duplicate-H1 pages are among them and still cannot be re-checked.
claude-seo toolchain unavailable (Python 3.9.6, no Homebrew): no Lighthouse, no screenshots, no PDF report.
No Google, DataForSEO, Moz or Bing credentials: no indexation, ranking, traffic or backlink data in any of the three audits.
